proposed_widenings.name: activation_resource: active_duration_pool
proposed_widenings.justification: Boots of Speed do not expend a discrete use or a charge per activation. They provide a pooled 10 minutes of active runtime per Long Rest, and that budget is shared across repeated on/off toggles. Current ActivationResource shapes only model discrete uses or charge pools spent at activation time, not elapsed active-duration consumption.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you've used the boots' property for a total of 10 minutes, the magic ceases to function for you until you finish a Long Rest.

proposed_widenings.name: activated_ability: toggleable_persistent_effect
proposed_widenings.justification: The boots are activated with a Bonus Action, remain active until manually ended, and can be ended by taking the same Bonus Action again. Current ActivatedAbilityMechanics can model a one-shot timed duration, but not a stateful on/off toggle that pauses and later resumes against the same remaining budget.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you click your heels together again, you end the effect.

proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_advantage: opportunity_attack_only filter
proposed_widenings.justification: The disadvantage rider applies only to Opportunity Attack attack rolls made against the wearer. Existing modify_roll_advantage can target attack rolls generally, and can narrow by attacker creature type, but it cannot scope the rider to the opportunity-attack subset. Encoding it as all attack rolls would be a scope lie; encoding it as deny_opportunity_attack would overstate the effect.
proposed_widenings.evidence: any creature that makes an Opportunity Attack against you has Disadvantage on the attack roll

notes: The core family fit is still magic_item + activation, and the underlying effects are existing v4 concepts: doubled speed maps to set_speed_ratio and the OA rider maps to modify_roll_advantage. The blocker is surface shape, not a new atom. No Dhall/JSON/trace was authored because any current encoding would misrepresent the toggle semantics and/or broaden the OA rider beyond RAW.
